{{Short description|Soviet and Russian mathematician}}
'''Sergei''' (or '''Sergey''') '''Viktorovich Bochkarev''' (or '''Bočkarev''') (Сергей Викторович Бочкарёв, July 24, 1941, in Kuybyshev now renamed [[Samara]] – July 8, 2021<ref>{{Cite web |title=Steklov Mathematical Institute |url=https://mi.ras.ru/index.php?c=show_dep&id=5&l=1 |access-date=2026-08-20 |website=mi.ras.ru}}</ref>) is a Soviet and Russian mathematician.

==Education and career==
He received in 1964 his undergraduate degree from [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]] and in 1969 his Russian [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree (PhD)  from [[Moscow State University]]. His dissertation о рядах Фурье по системе Хаара<ref>[http://www.nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/web_gak/lc/11380/52#pict 1969, Каталог РНБ (Catalog, Russian National Library]</ref> (On Fourier series in the Haar system) was supervised by [[Pyotr Lavrentyevich Ulyanov]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=130939|title=Sergey Victorovich Bochkarev}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Bochkarev, S. V.|title=On series in the Haar system|journal=Uspekhi Mat. Nauk|volume=24|issue=1(145)|year=1969|pages=189–190|url=http://www.mathnet.ru/php/archive.phtml?wshow=paper&jrnid=rm&paperid=5457&option_lang=eng}}</ref> From Moscow State University, Bochkarev received in 1974 his Russian [[Doctor of Science]] degree (habilitation).<ref>[http://www.nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/web_gak/lc/11380/50 1974, Каталог РНБ (Catalog, National Library of Russia)]</ref> Since 1971 he has worked at the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]], where he holds the title of leading scientific researcher in the Department of Function Theory.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mi.ras.ru/index.php?c=show_dep&id=5&l=1|title=Bochkarev Sergei Viktorovich, Staff (with photos), Department of Function Theory|website=Steklov Mathematical Institute}}</ref>

His research deals with harmonic analysis, [[Bounded mean oscillation|BMO space]]s, [[Hardy space]]s, functional analysis, construction of orthogonal bases in various [[function spaces]], and exponential sums.

In 1977 he was awarded the [[Salem Prize]]. In 1978 he was an Invited Speaker with talk Метод усреднения в теории ортогональных рядов (The averaging method in the theory of orthogonal bases) at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Helsinki.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mi-ras.ru/index.php?c=persons_icm&l=1|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897|website=Steklov Mathematical Institute}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://www.ams.org/books/trans2/117/|title=Eight Lectures Delivered at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Helsinki, 1978|series=American Mathematical Society Translations: Series 2|year=1981|volume=117|doi=10.1090/trans2/117 |isbn=978-0-8218-3069-7 |mr=665105}} {{ISBN|978-0-8218-3069-7}} (print); {{ISBN|978-1-4704-3328-4}} (online)</ref>
